title: bluff-strategy-v1
description: A behavioral strategy profile for both players (CONTRACTS.md section 2). That every infoset of the game appears with every action, and that each row sums to 1 within 1e-6, is checked against the game by the normalizer (reference/fractions_util.py normalize_strategy).

prob.description: A nonnegative exact number string: a decimal, possibly in exponent form as Python repr prints a float ("1e-05", "2.5e-07"; at most 3 exponent digits), or a fraction p/q with q > 0. Converted exactly, never through a float.
